questionEn: How does “bases (hydroxides)” differ in meaning - choose the correct description?
questionUz: "Asoslar (gidroksidlar)" qanday ma'noda farq qiladi - to'g'ri tavsifni tanlang?
choicesEn: a group of complex substances whose molecule contains metal atoms and one or more hydroxyl groups (OH)
a group of complex substances whose molecules contain one or more metal atoms.
H₂O (two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom)
The interaction of an acid with a base to form salt and water
choicesUz: Molekulasida metall atomlari va bir yoki bir nechta gidroksil guruhlari (OH) bo'lgan murakkab moddalar guruhi
molekulalarida bir yoki bir nechta metall atomlari bo'lgan murakkab moddalar guruhi.
H₂O (ikki vodorod atomi va bitta kislorod atomi)
Tuz va suv hosil qilish uchun kislotaning asos bilan o'zaro ta'siri
explanationEn: Bases (hydroxides) are a group of complex substances whose molecules contain metal atoms and one or more hydroxyl groups (OH).
explanationUz: Asoslar (gidroksidlar) - molekulalarida metall atomlari va bir yoki bir nechta gidroksil guruhlari (OH) bo'lgan murakkab moddalar guruhi.
